Show the bayesAgriFlow capability registry

bayes_capabilities.Rd

The registry is explicit about which design structures are available through each engine. A backend is selected because it supports the requested scientific structure, not simply because it is installed.

bayes_capabilities(design = NULL)

Arguments

design

Optional design type used to filter the registry.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

# Example 1: all capabilities
bayes_capabilities()
